mentions.name: Arborary
mentions.description: An urban tree mapping platform that aggregates public tree data from city sources, with a data explorer and a new landing page being worked on for SEO. Current work focuses on data quality: vetting municipal sources and leveraging aerial photography to drive QA on tree records.
mentions.problem: City tree datasets have quality issues: duplicates with slight offsets (e.g., Cambridge, MA merging in Harvard's trees), trees plotted in the middle of roads, and locations at address level instead of tree level.
mentions.source_excerpt: Continued on my urban tree mapping kick from the last few months - it's continued to be a good way to stress test other projects of mine [3]. I've given it a new shiny landing page [1] so I can work on SEO a bit, I'll need to do a facelift on the data explorer to bring it in line stylistically.
mentions.author: efromvt
